# Data Analysis for Continuous Improvement

## Idea
Students who rate lesson videos as more effective tend to report higher understanding of the course.

## Analysis
I analyzed survey data comparing lesson video effectiveness and student understanding. After cleaning the data and converting responses to integers, I created multiple visualizations including scatterplots, line plots, and categorical plots.

The results show a clear positive relationship between lesson video effectiveness and student understanding. As lesson video effectiveness increases, student understanding also increases.

## Conclusion
The analysis supports the idea that improving lesson videos can improve student learning outcomes. I recommend investing in better lesson videos, including clearer explanations, step by step examples, and improved pacing.

One extension would be to analyze which aspects of videos matter most, such as length or clarity. A trade off is that improving videos requires more time and resources, but the benefits outweigh the costs.
